blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
At executive level, the main taxes form a frame for thinking about the company as a whole. Corporate tax reveals the profitability of the economic model. Payroll tax measures how much of the company's value lives in people. VAT exposes the flow of value through the operation. International withholding taxes signal how globally exposed the business really is.

Read together, these four taxes outline the shape of the business. A company where payroll tax dominates is a human-capital business. A company where VAT dominates is transaction-driven. A company where corporate tax dominates is generating real economic rent. A company where international withholding matters is operating far beyond its home jurisdiction.

Senior leaders who look at their tax profile this way see patterns that the P&L alone cannot show. Taxes, at this level, are a second lens on the business — sometimes harder to flatter than the first.

items.q: According to the text, what does corporate tax reveal?
options: How much value lives in people
The profitability of the economic model
How globally exposed the business is
The flow of value through the operation
items.why: "Corporate tax reveals the profitability of the economic model."

items.q: A company where payroll tax dominates is described as…
items.why: "A company where payroll tax dominates is a human-capital business."

items.q: What does the phrase "a second lens on the business" suggest about taxes?
options: Taxes offer an additional way of reading the company beyond the P&L
Taxes are less reliable than the P&L
Taxes are only a compliance obligation
items.why: Inferência: a metáfora da 'segunda lente' significa uma perspectiva adicional, complementar ao P&L.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which statement?
options: Reading the four taxes together outlines the shape of a business
The tax profile can reveal patterns the P&L conceals
Taxes can be harder to flatter than the profit statement
The P&L alone tells executives everything they need to know
items.why: Inferência: o texto afirma o oposto — os impostos mostram o que o P&L sozinho não revela.

items.q: What does "sometimes harder to flatter than the first" imply about the tax lens?
options: It can expose realities the P&L might dress up more favourably
It always agrees with the P&L
It is irrelevant to strategic decisions
It is easier to manipulate than the P&L
items.why: Inferência: 'harder to flatter' sugere que os impostos são menos maquiáveis, revelando a realidade crua.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry apresentando o perfil tributário ao novo CFO. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome aboard. Before we get into any numbers, I want to walk you through a single page — the tax profile. It's the fastest way I know to see what kind of business we actually are, and it rarely tells the same story the P&L does.

Look at the four blocks here. Our corporate tax line is thin, which tells you we're not generating much economic rent — we operate on volume, not on margin. Now look at VAT: it dominates the page. That's the signature of a transaction-driven business, value flowing through us rather than accumulating in us.

What I'd draw your attention to is the international withholding column. Three years ago it was almost nothing. Today it's material, and it's growing every quarter. Nobody sat in a room and decided to become a global business — but the tax profile has been quietly telling us we already are one.

So my advice, on your first week, is this: don't read these figures as a compliance cost. Read them as a diagnosis. The page won't flatter you the way the earnings slide will, and that's precisely why it's worth ten minutes of your time.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Harry say the thin corporate tax line tells the CFO?
options: The company operates on high margins
The company is not generating much economic rent
items.why: "Our corporate tax line is thin, which tells you we're not generating much economic rent."

items.q: According to Harry, what does the dominant VAT line signal?
items.why: "That's the signature of a transaction-driven business."

items.q: What does Harry say about the international withholding column?
options: It has stayed the same for years
It is the smallest line on the page
It was almost nothing three years ago but is now material and growing
items.why: "Three years ago it was almost nothing. Today it's material, and it's growing every quarter."

items.q: What does Harry imply with "Nobody sat in a room and decided to become a global business"?
options: The company should stop operating abroad
The company became global through deliberate strategy
The company drifted into global operations without a conscious decision
items.why: Inferência: a mudança foi gradual e não planejada — o perfil tributário revelou algo que a liderança não decidiu ativamente.

items.q: How would you best describe Harry's overall message to the CFO?
options: Ignore the tax profile and focus on earnings
Delegate the tax review to the finance team
Read the tax profile as a candid diagnosis of the business
Treat the tax page as a routine compliance chore
items.why: Inferência: ele pede explicitamente 'read them as a diagnosis', contrastando com o slide de lucros que 'favorece'.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The four taxes give the board a frame for judging the company." Here frame means…
options: a structured way of interpreting something
items.why: Frame = enquadramento: uma estrutura mental para interpretar o negócio.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "When a firm's value sits mostly in its staff, it is a ___ business."
items.why: Human-capital business = negócio de capital humano, onde o valor vive nas pessoas.

items.q: "A company generating real economic rent is one that…"
options: earns returns above the competitive norm
items.why: Economic rent = renda econômica: retorno acima do que a mera concorrência permitiria.

items.q: "Read together, the taxes outline the shape of the business." To outline here means to…
options: sketch or reveal the broad form of
items.why: To outline = delinear, mostrar os contornos gerais — não os detalhes exatos.

items.q: "The earnings slide tends to flatter performance." To flatter here means to…
options: present something more favourably than it truly is
items.why: To flatter = favorecer, fazer parecer melhor do que realmente é.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões executivas sobre estratégia tributária. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The board still has to sign off on the new tax strategy." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We will roll out the new reporting frame across all jurisdictions." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = implementar de forma progressiva, área por área.

items.q: "The tax team pushed back on the CFO's classification." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, contestar — sem necessariamente rejeitar de vez.

items.q: "Reframing the taxes as a diagnosis really moved the needle in the boardroom." This means it…
items.why: Move the needle = mexer o ponteiro, produzir uma diferença perceptível.

items.q: "Once the frame is agreed, we must follow through and monitor it quarterly." To follow through means to…
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim aquilo que foi combinado.
